request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:MARKSMAN

layers.text: Make the tunic and flying cap one flat bright red with a slightly darker red shadow, never pink or crimson, and make the tunic bigger, covering chest, belly and legs to the knees. Make brown gloves, straps, belt and satchel charcoal grey. Keep the olive face, long ear, iron goggles, the big black bomb raised high with its pale spark, pose, outline and style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
